notes: Verified against two official ELAN/Nortek documents: the gSC10 Quick Install Guide (elanportal.com, rear-panel diagram) and the gSC10 spec sheet (ELAN/Nortek Security & Control, Rev-A 02/2018, mirrored by alltrade.co.uk). This is a home-automation control processor with NO video ports (no HDMI) despite some third-party summaries incorrectly attributing an HDMI OSD port to it (that belongs to the related ELAN g1 controller, not the gSC10). Wi-Fi 802.11 b/g/n with a detachable R-SMA external antenna is present but omitted from the port list since it is wireless, not a physical cabled signal port. The Sense inputs are 3.5mm stereo mini-plug jacks and the IR outputs are 3.5mm mono jacks; "trs-3.5" was used for both as the closest match in the allowed connector list (no mono-only 3.5mm id exists). The 10 relay connections use removable 2-position screw terminal blocks, mapped to "euroblock" as the closest listed connector type. RS-232 and RS-485 ports are physically RJ-45 jacks carrying serial signal (adaptors to DB9 are included in the box), consistent with the manufacturer's own "RJ-45 Port" labeling in the CONNECTIONS table. No grade applies to relay, sense, IR, DC power, or euroblock connectors per the grading rules. Ethernet grade set to eth-100m per the spec sheet's explicit "10/100 Mbps" rating even though the RJ-45 also carries PoE. Rack mountable at 1U (17"W x 2.25"H x 14"D), ships with rack ears.

ports.name: DC Power In
